summary.decision_summary: Millan’s Last Supper won by 47.3. Millan’s Last Supper left 5.5 lineup points on the table, while Sigma Chi Whiteout left 14.0.
summary.historical_summary: Millan’s Last Supper is 5-6 against Sigma Chi Whiteout across 11 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Millan’s Last Supper
summary.winner_reason: Millan’s Last Supper won by 47.3, led by a 35.3-point edge at WR. The leading starters were Davante Adams (38.5) and Jared Goff (35.6).
summary.loser_reason: Sigma Chi Whiteout could not match the opponent's WR production, losing that position battle by 35.3 points. Dallas Goedert scored 0.4. A best legal lineup added 14.0, still short of the 47.3-point margin.
